messages:
anya: FYI publish CI failed for @redwood/sampleapp during release-stamp. typegen regen introduced a param/signature ordering change and changelog-check blocked publish. CI: https://ci.redwood/example/2421
ci-bot: Build #2421 failed: release-checks — changelog-check exited 1 (see logs) :x:
jack: which files did the regen change? short diff pls
anya: boiled down: typegen/types.ts changed signature order for createSession and a couple helpers (optional args moved before required ones). tiny but semver-sensitive. snippet: `createSession(opts?: CreateOpts, userId?: string)` used to be `createSession(userId: string, opts?: CreateOpts)`
leo: ugh. I think the codegen option preserveParameterOrder got flipped in the last codegen config refactor. saw a PR that touched codegen/config.ts yesterday.
sam: do we treat param-order-only changes as breaking for our TS sdks? TS callers might break if positional call used. semver guard is technically correct.
maya: two paths: revert generator change so regen is parity with published types, or add changelog entry and bump minor. which is faster for release? :thinking_face:
jack: I can try a targeted fix to typegen to prefer legacy ordering. will run local regen, commit, and push a hotfix branch.
anya: note: release-stamp enforces changelog entry to match semver bump. current package.json version for sampleapp is 1.12.3 so a minor bump -> 1.13.0 expected if we accept change.
jack: running locally now:
```
yarn workspace @redwood/sampleapp typegen:regen
git add packages/sampleapp/types
git commit -m "typegen: preserve legacy param ordering"
```
ci-bot: tip: you can run `./scripts/release-stamp --check-changelog` and `./scripts/release-stamp --dry-run` to validate before opening the PR
leo: also flagging that the same commit touched auth/retry codegen tests — might be unrelated but worth eyeballing. opened a quick GH draft issue: https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/4567
sam: pinging @build-team: can we loosen the release-stamp rule to accept ordering-only type changes temporarily? or at least print a clearer diff in the failure message so DX isn't guessing. :eyes:
maya: temporary pragmatic play: add a changelog line "typegen: preserve param order changes — minor bump" and land. faster than reverting if we need to cut a release today. then follow up with a generator config revert in next patch cycle.
jack: good plan. I'll open PR with regen + changelog entry. will include before/after snippet in PR description.
anya: thanks — I'll hold off manual release until CI green. Jack, assign to me when PR ready and I'll coordinate the release step. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Build hints: if you hit flaky typegen due to node version differences, try `nvm use 18 && yarn rebuild-types` before committing.
maya: created a quick checklist in the PR template to avoid this getting missed next time: (1) run regen locally, (2) run release-stamp --check-changelog, (3) ensure changelog entry or revert generator flag.
anya: awesome. keeping this short — cc: @jack @leo @sam for follow-ups. updates in this thread please.
